Author: Jakub Olek
Name: Agent Sessions
Description: Claude Code sessions and T3 Code threads on keys: highlights the ones waiting for you, opens them on press, and approves permission prompts in two presses.

Actions.Name: Claude Session
Actions.Tooltip: One Claude Code session slot. Add several keys; sessions fill them most-urgent first.

Actions.Name: T3 Session
Actions.Tooltip: One T3 Code thread slot. Add several keys; threads fill them most-urgent first. Needs the T3 Code desktop app running.
